plugins.name: appaudit
plugins.description: Non-destructive security assessments for systems you own or have the owner's written permission to test: web apps, APIs, mobile/IoT apps, firmware, AI agents, and plugins, skills and MCP servers before you install them. Enforced scope, hash-chained evidence, independent verification, regulatory flags for 9 jurisdictions, six audit-ready outputs. Not a certification.
